question: Kelantan2026_Q35
explanation:

English: A concave lens forms an upright, diminished virtual image of a real object, so B is correct.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Penang2026_Q35
explanation:
中文：从透镜光学中心到焦点的距离称为焦距。
English: The distance from a lens's optical centre to its focal point is the focal length.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Sarawak2026_Q35
explanation:
中文：凹透镜使光线发散，其反向延长线在物体同侧相交，形成正立、缩小的虚像，因此选A。
English: A concave lens diverges light; the backward extensions of the rays meet on the object's side, forming a virtual, upright and diminished image. Therefore A is correct.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Kelantan2026_Q36
explanation:
中文：物体位于凸透镜2F处时，像形成于另一侧2F处，倒立但大小与物体相同。
English: With the object at 2F of a convex lens, the image forms at 2F on the other side, inverted and equal in size.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Melaka2026_Q36
explanation:
中文：同一拍摄距离下，P视野较广、人物较小，表示焦距较短；Q焦距较长。
English: At the same camera distance, P shows a wider field and a smaller subject, indicating a shorter focal length than Q.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: N92026_Q36

English: The concave lens shown forms an upright, diminished virtual image of a real object, so B is correct.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Pahang2026_Q36
explanation:
中文：像距从透镜光学中心量到像所在位置，图中这段距离标为A。
English: Image distance is measured from the lens's optical centre to the image position, labelled A.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Penang2026_Q36
explanation:
中文：标本位于物镜F与2F之间，形成放大的实像，再由目镜继续放大。
English: The specimen lies between F and 2F of the objective, forming an enlarged real image that the eyepiece magnifies further.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Sarawak2026_Q36
explanation:
中文：凸透镜可把远处物体的光会聚在感光器上，形成倒立、缩小的实像。因此CCTV使用凸透镜，选B。
English: A convex lens focuses light from a distant object onto a sensor, forming a real, inverted and diminished image. Therefore B is correct for a CCTV camera.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Selangor2026_Q36

English: The parallel rays converge after passing through X, identifying a convex lens. D is thick in the centre and thin at the edges, so it is correct.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Melaka2026_Q37
explanation:
中文：物体位于F与2F之间，折射光在另一侧实际相交，形成倒立、放大的实像。
English: The object lies between F and 2F. Refracted rays meet on the other side, forming a real, inverted, enlarged image.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: N92026_Q37

English: A shorter focal length gives a wider angle of view for the same sensor size, capturing a larger field.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Selangor2026_Q37

English: Total microscope magnification = eyepiece magnification × objective magnification. The objective is 900 ÷ 20 = 45 times, so B is correct.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Terengganu2026_Q37
explanation:

English: A convex lens refracts parallel light so it converges at a focal point. Its main function is to converge light, so C is correct; it does not operate by reflection.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Kl2026_Q38
explanation:
中文：放大镜把物体置于凸透镜焦距内，产生正立、放大的虚像。
English: A magnifying glass places the object within a convex lens's focal length, producing an upright, enlarged virtual image.

question: Perak2026_Q38

English: Changing the objective from 10× to 40× with a 10× eyepiece raises total magnification from 100× to 400×; blur still requires focusing.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Putrajaya2026_Q38
explanation:

English: A convex lens forms a real, inverted, enlarged image when the object lies between F and 2F.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Sbp2026_Q38
explanation:
中文：物体放在凸透镜的2F处，会在另一侧2F形成等大、倒立的实像，适用于等比例复印。因此选位于2F的B。
English: An object at 2F of a convex lens produces a real, inverted image of the same size at 2F on the other side. This suits same-size photocopying, so B is correct.
